coverage: Read the complete available local article body; linked images, videos and external claims not independently inspected.
basis: Practitioner account / proposed exercise; no direct causal evaluation of the extracted practice.
reported_outcomes: Author reports an emotionally meaningful conversation.
limits: A meaningful experience does not establish access to hidden motives. Creative reader-response hypotheses would require reframing and external checks, not adoption of the original mind-reading premise.
review_note: Asks a model to infer what the user is not saying; interprets a responsive exchange as shared understanding.
author: Sam Illingworth
